```{r setup}
#| fig.keep: "none"
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.keep = "none")
source("../R/onepager.R")

work <- section_rows("work_experience")
current <- work |> filter(is.na(end) | end == "")
# The one page keeps the positions that tell the sanitation data story and the
# origin of the rstatsZH course; the short intern and consultant stints stay in
# the full CV (cv-pdf.qmd).
previous_keys <- tibble::tribble(
  ~institution,                                 ~start,
  "Aquaconsult Limited",                        "2018",
  "Inter-American Development Bank",            "2019",
  "Biomass Controls PBC",                       "2017",
  "World Health Organization",                  "2016",
  "Eawag / Sandec",                             "2012",
  "PRG, University of KwaZulu-Natal",           "2011",
  "Statistical Office of the Canton of Zurich", "2021"
)
previous <- work |> semi_join(previous_keys, by = c("institution", "start"))
edu      <- section_rows("education") |> filter(str_detect(title, "Dipl|RStudio"))
roles    <- section_rows("professional_roles")
grants   <- section_rows("grants") |> filter(is.na(status) | status == "funded")
awards   <- section_rows("awards")
# Courses since 2021; rows whose start equals their end are one-off workshops
# and stay in the full CV.
teaching <- section_rows("teaching") |>
  filter(as.integer(substr(ifelse(is.na(end) | end == "", "9999", end), 1, 4)) >= 2021,
         is.na(end) | end != start)

text_block <- function(loc) aboutme::text_blocks$text[aboutme::text_blocks$loc == loc]

contact_links <- function() {
  ci <- aboutme::contact_info
  out <- character()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(ci))) {
    v <- ci$contact[i]
    out <- c(out, switch(ci$icon[i],
      envelope = typst_link(paste0("mailto:", v), v),
      globe    = typst_link(v),
      orcid    = typst_link(paste0("https://orcid.org/", v), paste("ORCID", v)),
      github   = typst_link(paste0("https://", v), v),
      linkedin = typst_link(paste0("https://", v), v),
      typst_link(v)))
  }
  # The links sit inside a Typst array (code mode), where #link is plain link.
  paste0("(", paste(sub("^#", "", out), collapse = ", "), ")")
}
position_line <- paste(sprintf("%s, %s", typst_esc(current$title), typst_esc(current$institution)),
                       collapse = ". ")
```

```{r header, results='asis'}
cat("\n```{=typst}\n")
cat(sprintf("#name-block([Lars Schöbitz], [%s.], %s)\n", position_line, contact_links()))
cat("```\n\n")
cat(text_block("intro"), "\n\n")
```
